remarks: Tucked at the end of a long, private drive in a serene park-like setting near the storybook village and golf course of Pound Ridge this European-inspired stone & cedar estate offers timeless sophistication, refined craftsmanship, & exceptional privacy. Custom built to exacting standards & renovated by renowned Architect Chris Kofitsas of New World Design Builders, it blends classical architecture with an effortless lifestyle. From the moment you enter, soaring cathedral ceilings, elegant millwork, & streaming natural light create a sense of grandeur. The main-level primary suite is a tranquil retreat w/French doors opening to a covered veranda, resort-style pool, spa, and lushly landscaped grounds. A playground and zipline tucked among mature trees adds charm & joy. The formal dining room shines with a dramatic Palladian window & sweeping views. A butler's pantry leads to the fireside country kitchen warm, inviting, & ideal for gatherings. A sunlit pool room, mudroom, 2 1/2 baths & laundry complete the main floor. Upstairs, recently remodeled has three beautifully appointed bedrooms-one en-suite, adjoined by a spacious en-suite suite/great room with office space -baths w/heated flrs. The finished lower level offers 2,300 sq ft, incl. a fam room w/illuminated cherry built-ins, a hidden office behind a bookshelf, playroom, gym, den & walk-out access to the beautiful grounds. Just 1 hour from NYC this is a truly exceptional home that epitomizes quiet luxury and enduring elegance
